title: Toleka Kiz
description:
🌍 TOLEKA KIZ 🌍
📅 January 14–18, 2027
📍 Gothenburg, Sweden
🏨 Best Western Plus Åby Hotel
Get ready for Toleka Kiz, an international dance festival bringing Sweden back to its historic All-in-One Kizomba experience. Created by a passionate and talented team, this event delivers fresh energy and a high-level dance experience. Expect rising stars, top artists, and an unforgettable atmosphere. Our mission is to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment where everyone feels at home🌍
